fixedRules: escape.raft and its shore-launch, sailcloth, hull, supply and sea-window contract are read-only.
Day 50 is the default terminal; a completed escape resolves immediately on any day and outranks Day 50 settlement.
Five escape, six region, seven hazard and nineteen ending stable catalogs are unchanged.
Flare and beacon must each differ from smoke, radio and raft on at least two player-action axes.
A project is completed through direct world-object interactions, never a shared global crafting or completion button.
Preview, cancel, locale and input-device changes are mutation-free.
All costs, preparation ranges, window frequencies, failure probabilities and behavior thresholds remain SAMPLE_ONLY.

canonicalAliasPolicy.aliasRule: Aliases may be read by an internal developer-fixture migration only; new display, save, log and probe output must use canonical IDs.

directInteraction.popupRule: Only the latched object's requirements, next milestone, window and risk are visible; movement and world Interact are locked until cancel or result acknowledgement.
directInteraction.cancelRule: Return to the same object, position and facing with zero resource, RNG, project and focus-graph mutation.

routes.fantasy: Prepare one protected shot, read a short witnessed visibility window and decide whether to fire safely or risk the cartridge.
routes.anchorRule: Fixed camp shoreline anchor; no free placement or relocation.

keyPart.escrowRule: Load moves the part into project escrow without consuming it; unload before a shot returns it atomically; shot resolution consumes at most one.

windowRules: Closed blocks confirm and consumes nothing.
Uncertain exposes no-witness risk and cartridge consumption before risky confirm.
Perfect records event.flare.perfect-window but creates no new ending or achievement ID.
A UI-confirmed safe window cannot resolve no-witness for a hidden reason.
atomicFailureRules: Misfire and no-witness consume at most the selected cartridge and prepared payload once.
Launcher-damaged before fire blocks confirm and does not consume escrow.
Research, facility and unrelated escape stages survive every declared failure.
A spent missing cartridge re-enters the canonical eligible-search pity path.
Retry of one attemptId returns already_resolved without another spend, score or event.

requiredSteps: compare flare source and weather data on the expedition map
complete real search and return for the cartridge and materials
install and approach the fixed launcher
prepare, escrow-load and fire in a confirmed window
resolve escape.flare and one existing flare ending
naturalSlice.failureFixture: Resolve one uncertain no-witness or telegraphed misfire, then prove a replacement cartridge can be reacquired and retried naturally.

routes.fantasy: Travel to a fixed ruined relay, repair access, generator and signal head in place, recover from storm damage and activate a visible ridge light.
routes.anchorRule: Fixed world anchor in the relay-region path; no free placement, relocation or global remote completion.

keyPart.installationRule: Move the protected coil into project inventory on the power milestone; hazards cannot delete it.

weatherRules: Storm-eye requires event.disaster.perfect-mitigation in the same telegraphed hazard chain.
Rain and lightning warning block activation but do not date-lock repair actions.
Only a resolved lightning event can trip power.
atomicFailureRules: Power-drop changes powered to false only.
Stair-collapse changes access to blocked only.
Lightning-trip changes breaker and powered only.
All three completed milestones and the installed coil survive every failure overlay.
Direct repair or reset commits once; retry returns already_resolved.

requiredSteps: unlock a highland or relay path through actual searches and returns
acquire the canonical coil and materials and complete both research IDs
interact directly with access, generator and signal-head targets
resolve and recover one failure overlay without milestone loss
activate in clear-night or storm-eye window
resolve escape.beacon and one existing beacon ending

transactionContract.idempotency: The same run, escape, action, attempt and stage version can commit once; retries return already_resolved or already_completed.
transactionContract.terminalPriority: escape_complete resolves immediately on every day including Day 50 and precedes Day 50 settlement.

redFirstGates.initialRed: Flare is data-only and its current provisional definition may omit canonical region or material IDs.
redFirstGates.green: All canonical sets are exact and playableState is playable.

redFirstGates.initialRed: No live launcher, popup, escrow or witness-window interaction trace exists.
redFirstGates.green: Real far-near-popup-load-window-fire-field-or-terminal trace with grant and warp counts zero.

redFirstGates.initialRed: Shot result, failure consumption and replacement retry are not implemented.
redFirstGates.green: Closed costs zero, uncertain is explicit, at most one cartridge is consumed, retry duplicates zero and replacement remains reachable.

redFirstGates.initialRed: No fresh natural playable flare terminal evidence exists.
redFirstGates.green: Map-search-return-research-install-fire-ending completes in the SAMPLE 30-minute slice without debug assistance.

redFirstGates.initialRed: Beacon is data-only and provisional runtime aliases diverge from canonical IDs.
redFirstGates.green: Only canonical IDs are displayed, saved, logged and probed; three targets exist and playableState is playable.

redFirstGates.initialRed: No live relay object or three spatial milestone interactions exist.
redFirstGates.green: Access, generator and signal-head traces each commit one distinct milestone and cancel changes nothing.

redFirstGates.initialRed: Failure overlays, weather activation and in-place recovery are not implemented.
redFirstGates.green: Power-drop, stair-collapse and lightning-trip preserve milestones and coil; direct recovery and retry duplicate nothing.

redFirstGates.initialRed: No fresh natural playable beacon terminal evidence exists.
redFirstGates.green: Unlock-search-research-three-repairs-window-activation-ending completes in the SAMPLE 45-minute slice without debug assistance.

redFirstGates.initialRed: Live flare and beacon cannot yet prove terminal priority, localized surfaces or focus parity.
redFirstGates.green: Both routes complete in any band, Day 50 escape wins, KO and EN meaning match, qps-long fits and keyboard/gamepad focus semantics match.

outOfScope: final resource costs, preparation days, window frequency or failure probability

tasks.title: Wave 20 조명탄·고지대 신호 플레이 가능 확장 계약
tasks.description: 기존 뗏목과 Day 50 계약을 보존하면서 escape.flare와 escape.beacon의 canonical 데이터, 직접 오브젝트 상태기계, 날씨 창, 실패·재시도, 원자성, 엔딩 modifier와 SAMPLE_ONLY 최소 세로 조각을 고정한다.
acceptanceCriteria: escape.raft와 Day 50·조기 탈출·5경로·19엔딩 정본을 바꾸지 않는다.
flare와 beacon이 각각 기존 세 경로와 최소 두 행동 축 이상 다르고 공용 제작 완료 버튼을 쓰지 않는다.
canonical region/research/facility/key-part ID, 직접 object state, window, 실패 overlay, transaction과 ending modifier가 기계 판독 가능하다.
각 경로의 no-grant/no-warp playable 최소 slice와 red-first FAIL→GREEN 조건이 있다.
KO/EN/qps-long과 keyboard/gamepad 공통 focus, compact prompt와 전용 popup을 보존한다.
비용·기간·빈도·확률·점수는 SAMPLE_ONLY이고 인간 결과를 꾸며내지 않는다.

tasks.title: Wave 20 조명탄 red-first 게이트
tasks.description: W20-F01~F04와 공통 X01의 조명탄 부분을 현재 data-only 상태에서 의미 있게 실패시키는 결정론 probe와 자연 Play 수용 test를 먼저 만든다.
acceptanceCriteria: catalog load나 reflection만으로 PASS하지 않고 실제 launcher interaction 부재로 RED가 난다.
canonical 전체 집합, window 공정성, cartridge 최대 1 소비, retry와 자연 경로를 각각 독립 assertion으로 둔다.
현재 실패 gate ID와 원인을 기록하며 구현 전 GREEN을 주장하지 않는다.

tasks.title: Wave 20 조명탄 플레이 가능 최소 세로 조각
tasks.description: red-first 뒤 canonical flare launcher, escrow, witnessed window, 단발 실패·재시도와 즉시 조기 탈출을 실제 object interaction으로 구현한다.
acceptanceCriteria: W20-F01~F04와 X01 flare 부분을 동일 probe로 GREEN 전환한다.
fresh save SAMPLE 30분 경로에서 grant·warp·skip 없이 기존 flare ending 하나로 terminal한다.
escape.raft와 smoke/radio 상태·비용·terminal을 바꾸지 않는다.

tasks.title: Wave 20 조명탄 GREEN·회귀 검증
tasks.description: 조명탄 red-first gate, 자연 slice, 기존 smoke/radio/raft와 Day 50 우선순위 회귀를 같은 빌드에서 검증한다.
acceptanceCriteria: W20-F01~F04와 X01 flare 부분이 실제 Play 증거로 GREEN이다.
실패·취소·retry·locale/input 전환의 추가 소비·점수·해금이 0이다.
기존 세 경로와 Day 50 회귀가 없다.

tasks.title: Wave 20 고지대 중계소 red-first 게이트
tasks.description: flare GREEN 뒤 W20-B01~B04와 X01 beacon 부분을 현재 data-only alias·상호작용 부재 상태에서 의미 있게 실패시키는 gate를 만든다.
acceptanceCriteria: 비정본 alias와 playable=false를 독립 RED로 잡는다.
세 target/milestone, failure overlay 보존, window activation과 자연 경로가 각각 실패한다.
reflection·data resolver만으로 playable PASS를 만들지 않는다.

tasks.title: Wave 20 고지대 중계소 플레이 가능 최소 세로 조각
tasks.description: canonical relay station과 coil, 세 현장 milestone, 날씨 창, 재해 overlay 복구와 즉시 조기 탈출을 실제 object interaction으로 구현한다.
acceptanceCriteria: W20-B01~B04와 X01 beacon 부분을 동일 probe로 GREEN 전환한다.
fresh save SAMPLE 45분 경로에서 grant·warp·skip 없이 기존 beacon ending 하나로 terminal한다.
완료 milestone과 coil은 power-drop/stair-collapse/lightning-trip에서 보존된다.

tasks.title: Wave 20 고지대 중계소 GREEN·전체 탈출 회귀 검증
tasks.description: beacon red-first gate와 자연 slice를 GREEN으로 전환하고 5개 탈출법·Day 50·19엔딩·최소 3경로 softlock 보호를 회귀 검증한다.
acceptanceCriteria: W20-B01~B04와 X01 전체가 실제 Play 증거로 GREEN이다.
5개 탈출 stable ID, 최소 3경로 softlock 보호와 ending 우선순위가 보존된다.
최종 수치·실제 Steam·인간 50일 완주·물리 게임패드는 별도 증거 전까지 승격하지 않는다.

decisions.summary: 뗏목 계약 다음에는 단발 window·escrow를 검증하는 escape.flare를 먼저 구현하고, 그 GREEN 위에 세 현장 milestone과 재해 복구가 필요한 escape.beacon을 구현한다.
decisions.rationale: 작은 상태기계에서 직접 상호작용·window·원자 retry를 먼저 안정화한 뒤 더 복잡한 원격 고정 시설로 확장한다.

decisions.summary: beacon은 research.structural-repair, research.generator-repair, facility.relay-station, part.beacon.generator-coil만 canonical로 사용하고 현재 data-only 임시 별칭을 공개 ID로 승격하지 않는다.
flare는 목격 창의 단발 위험 결정, beacon은 원격 고정 폐시설의 access·generator·signal-head 복구로 플레이 문법을 분리한다.
decisions.rationale: 같은 제작 버튼에서 재료명만 바꾸는 탈출법을 방지하고 각 경로에 다른 공간·시간·실패 판단을 준다.

decisions.summary: Wave 20 비용·준비 기간·창 빈도·실패 확률·행동 임계는 playable fixture용 SAMPLE_ONLY이며 자연 세션과 별도 승인 전 정식 50일 밸런스가 아니다.
decisions.rationale: 기능 상태기계 검증과 장기 캠페인 튜닝 증거를 분리한다.
